name: ampere-plus-r5-srcg50-int8
description: r5 = layer-selective INT8 stagewise UNet srcg50 (gmac_0.50 recipe) bs16 + TensorRT TAESD bs8, built with TensorRT hardware compatibility AMPERE_PLUS: one set of plans for every GPU of compute capability 8.0-9.0 (RTX 30xx/40xx, A-series, L40S, A100, H100). Same ONNX per block as the RTX 4070 SUPER set; 307 fps vs 401 fps on the build GPU (docs/fps_comparisons/ampere_plus_r5_20260930). Built 2026-09-30 on an RTX 4070 SUPER, driver 595.84, torch 2.5.1+cu121, TensorRT 10.3.0.
